title: Preparing a Personal Portfolio for Release Readiness
excerpt: A draft look at the release-readiness process behind a Vite-based personal portfolio, including route review, documentation updates, governance checks, and deployment validation before public launch.

sections.heading: Project Overview
sections.body: Trevis Portfolio is a personal portfolio application built with Vite. The site is intended to present professional background and project content through routes such as Home, About, and Projects. At this stage, the project remains in progress and should be treated as a release candidate rather than a published portfolio.

sections.heading: Release Readiness Focus
sections.body: The current project phase is Release Readiness, with governance marked as pass-with-gaps. That status is useful: it shows that the application is moving toward launch while still identifying specific items that need remediation or manual review. The next planned action is to remediate BUG-001 and then run Release Readiness with live Vercel validation.

sections.heading: Screenshots captured for review
sections.body: RidgePath Forge captured 4 local screenshot drafts for portfolio review. These images remain draft assets until reviewed and promoted into public project media.

sections.heading: Governance and Content Review
sections.body: The most important open issue is BUG-001, which reports that a tracked Power Automate Desktop source export is documented as containing sensitive credential material. Before any public launch, this item should be remediated and verified. Additional governance work includes removing, scrubbing, or formally governing the tracked export and completing a public content and media review for resume, contact information, screenshots, and case-study claims.

sections.heading: Testing and Deployment Validation
sections.body: The backlog includes adding route and asset smoke tests for the portfolio SPA and verifying production deployment behavior, including direct route refresh behavior on Vercel. Local screenshots have already been captured for the Home, About, and Projects routes, but those screenshots should be reviewed before publishing.

sections.heading: Documentation Improvements
sections.body: Documentation remains part of the release plan. The README needs updates to reflect the current routes, case studies, scripts, and project structure. A future documentation task also proposes capturing the repeatable intake-to-case-study promotion workflow, which would help make future portfolio updates more consistent and reviewable.
